1	// Package game implements core MTG game objects according to the Comprehensive Rules
2	package game
3	
4	import (
5		"strings"
6		"sync"
7		"time"
8	)
9	
10	// ContinuousEffect represents an active continuous effect on the battlefield
11	// Rule 611 - Continuous Effects
12	type ContinuousEffect struct {
13		ID               string `json:"id"`
14		Source           *Card  `json:"-"` // The card generating this effect
15		SourceID         string `json:"source_id"`
16		SourceController int    `json:"source_controller"` // Controller of the source when effect was created
17		Timestamp        int64  `json:"timestamp"`         // For ordering (Rule 613.7)
18	
19		// ConditionFn gates conditional ("as long as …") effects: when set and it
20		// returns false, the effect applies to nothing. Evaluated live on every
21		// application, so the effect switches on/off with the game state.
22		// Not serialized — a rebuilt game re-registers effects via card handlers.
23		ConditionFn func() bool `json:"-"`
24	
25		// RuntimeCondition is the v2 "as long as …" static condition (schema-v2
26		// Change 2, re-parse R0c: static_conditional), precomputed at conversion
27		// time from AbilityDSL.Condition via ConvertCondition. It carries no
28		// closure, so it survives copying/inspection; GameState.RegisterCardAbilities
29		// is what turns it into a live ConditionFn (mirrors TriggeredAbility.
30		// RuntimeCondition/EvaluateCondition, extended here to gate continuous
31		// effects instead of trigger-time checks).
32		RuntimeCondition *ConditionSpec `json:"-"`
33	
34		// What is being modified
35		PowerMod     int  `json:"power_mod,omitempty"`
36		ToughnessMod int  `json:"toughness_mod,omitempty"`
37		SetPower     *int `json:"set_power,omitempty"`     // For "becomes X/Y" effects
38		SetToughness *int `json:"set_toughness,omitempty"` // For "becomes X/Y" effects
39	
40		// DynamicPowerMod / DynamicToughnessMod are pointer-backed additive
41		// modifiers (Layer 7c). Unlike the fixed PowerMod/ToughnessMod ints,
42		// these are mutated live inside ConditionFn by a closure that
43		// recomputes the boost from live game state — the same pattern
44		// SetPower/SetToughness use for CDAs, but for additive boosts.
45		// Not serialized (closures aren't JSON-safe).
46		DynamicPowerMod     *int `json:"-"`
47		DynamicToughnessMod *int `json:"-"`
48	
49		GrantKeyword Keyword `json:"grant_keyword,omitempty"`
50	
51		// EtbCounterGrant, when non-nil, marks this static ability as putting
52		// additional counters on OTHER qualifying permanents as THEY enter the
53		// battlefield (Rule 614.12 replacement effect keyed off a filter) — e.g.
54		// Gev, Scaled Scorch: "Other creatures you control enter with an
55		// additional +1/+1 counter ... for each opponent who lost life this
56		// turn", Metallic Mimic: "... of the chosen type enter with an
57		// additional +1/+1 counter", Tayam, Luminous Enigma: "Each other
58		// creature you control enters with an additional vigilance counter".
59		// Distinct from Card.EtbCounters (fires only for the card's OWN entry):
60		// this is consulted via EffectManager.GetEffectsAffecting for every
61		// OTHER permanent that enters while this effect is registered, reusing
62		// the existing AffectsFilter/AffectsSubtype/AffectsController/
63		// ExcludeSelf matching instead of a bespoke per-card
64		// EventEntersBattlefield subscriber. AmountVar (mirroring
65		// EtbCounterSpec.AmountVar) is resolved against the SOURCE's context
66		// (e.g. "opponents_lost_life_count", "source_power", "<subtype>_count")
67		// by GameState.applyOtherEntersWithCounterEffects, not the entering
68		// card's — the self-ETB AmountVar cases in applyEtbCounters
69		// (x/storm_count/creatures_died_this_turn) don't apply here.
70		EtbCounterGrant *EtbCounterSpec `json:"-"`
71	
72		// AddType grants an additional card type (Rule 613 Layer 4) to affected
73		// permanents, e.g. "Artifact" for "All permanents are artifacts in
74		// addition to their other types." Reversible: RemoveBySource strips it
75		// the moment the source leaves the battlefield.
76		AddType string `json:"add_type,omitempty"`
77	
78		// AddSubType grants an additional subtype (Rule 613 Layer 4) to
79		// affected permanents IN ADDITION to their existing subtypes, e.g.
80		// "Saproling" for "Forests are ... Saproling creatures in addition to
81		// their other types" (Life and Limb). Unlike SetSubTypes below (which
82		// REPLACES subtypes via direct mutation and only reverts at end of
83		// turn), this is live-evaluated through
84		// Card.HasSubTypeWithEffects/GetGrantedSubTypes the same way AddType
85		// is: it applies to any permanent that starts matching the effect's
86		// filter later (e.g. a Forest played after this effect is already
87		// active) and reverts automatically the instant the granting source
88		// leaves the battlefield (RemoveBySource).
89		AddSubType string `json:"add_subtype,omitempty"`
90	
91		// AddColor grants a color (Rule 613 Layer 5) to affected permanents,
92		// e.g. Green for "Forests are 1/1 green Saproling creatures ...".
93		// Live-evaluated via Card.HasColorWithEffects/GetGrantedColors with the
94		// same reversible-on-source-leaving semantics as AddType/AddSubType,
95		// unlike the direct-mutation, EOT-only SetColors field below.
96		AddColor Color `json:"add_color,omitempty"`
97	
98		// SetSubTypes/SetColors implement "becomes a green Wurm" style effects
99		// (Rule 613 Layers 4 & 5): they REPLACE the affected card's subtypes
100		// and/or colors outright, rather than adding to them. Unlike the other
101		// modifiers above, these are applied by directly mutating Card.SubTypes
102		// / Card.Colors when registered (see cardfns.SetSubTypesAndColorsUntilEOT)
103		// because most call sites read those fields straight off the card
104		// rather than through the effect layer. PreviousSubTypes/PreviousColors
105		// capture the prior values so CleanupEndOfTurnEffects can restore them
106		// when the effect expires.
107		SetSubTypes      []string `json:"set_subtypes,omitempty"`
108		PreviousSubTypes []string `json:"previous_subtypes,omitempty"`
109		SetColors        []Color  `json:"set_colors,omitempty"`
110		PreviousColors   []Color  `json:"previous_colors,omitempty"`
111	
112		// SetLandType/PreviousLandType implement "becomes a Forest"/"Forests
113		// are ... lands" land-type-changing effects (Rule 613.3d — the land-
114		// type analogue of SetSubTypes/SetColors just above). Card.LandType is
115		// likewise read directly by callers throughout the engine
116		// (createBasicLandAbility's mana-ability generation via
117		// GameState.GetCardAbilities, fetch-land searches in
118		// gamestate_tutor.go, aura "enchant Forest" legality in aura.go,
119		// Player.PlayLand's land-type handling) rather than through a layered
120		// Layer-4 grant list, so this is applied by direct mutation when
121		// registered (see cardfns.GrantLandType) instead of a live
122		// GetGranted*-style query. PreviousLandType captures the prior value so
123		// CleanupEndOfTurnEffects can restore it when an UntilEOT-scoped grant
124		// expires; a permanent-duration grant (no UntilEOT) is restored via a
125		// leaves-battlefield subscription instead, since RemoveBySource alone
126		// only strips ContinuousEffect list entries, not the direct mutation.
127		SetLandType      string `json:"set_land_type,omitempty"`
128		PreviousLandType string `json:"previous_land_type,omitempty"`
129	
130		// GrantsLandType marks effects that add the Land type to a permanent
131		// that is not already one (mirrors GrantsCreatureType/AnimatedAsCreature
132		// below, for AnimatedAsLand). CleanupEndOfTurnEffects reads this to
133		// reset AnimatedAsLand on the affected card at EOT.
134		GrantsLandType bool `json:"grants_land_type,omitempty"`
135	
136		// Variable power/toughness modifiers (for effects like "gets +X/+0 where X is mana value of artifacts")
137		PowerModSource        string `json:"power_mod_source,omitempty"`        // e.g., "mana_value_artifacts_other"
138		PowerModCondition     string `json:"power_mod_condition,omitempty"`     // Full condition text for debugging
139		PowerModNegate        bool   `json:"power_mod_negate,omitempty"`        // Subtract the variable amount (e.g., "gets -X/-0")
140		ToughnessModSource    string `json:"toughness_mod_source,omitempty"`    // e.g., for dynamic toughness
141		ToughnessModCondition string `json:"toughness_mod_condition,omitempty"` // Full condition text for debugging
142	
143		// pump_per_count (registry.go v2 primitive, task 1863): a live-recomputed
144		// per-unit P/T boost, evaluated fresh on every GetPowerBonus/
145		// GetToughnessBonus call exactly like PowerModSource/ToughnessModSource
146		// above (no ConditionFn/event-subscription bookkeeping needed) — but
147		// generalized to an arbitrary type/subtype/controller count instead of
148		// PowerModSource's closed enum, and to two more counting bases those
149		// enums can't express: "attached to THIS source" (e.g. Ancestral Mask:
150		// "+2/+2 for each other enchantment on the battlefield"; Kor Spiritdancer:
151		// "+2/+2 for each Aura attached to it") and "counters on THIS source"
152		// (e.g. Sigil of Distinction: "+1/+1 for each charge counter on this
153		// Equipment"). CountMode selects which basis:
154		//   "battlefield"          — count permanents on the battlefield matching
155		//                            CountFilter/CountSubtype/CountController/
156		//                            CountOther (default when CountMode == "")
157		//   "attached_to_source"   — count permanents attached to e.Source
158		//                            matching CountFilter/CountSubtype
159		//   "counters"             — count of CountCounterType counters on
160		//                            e.Source (CountFilter/CountSubtype/
161		//                            CountController/CountOther unused)
162		// See EffectManager.evaluatePerCount (effects.go) for the executor.
163		CountMode        string `json:"count_mode,omitempty"`
164		CountFilter      string `json:"count_filter,omitempty"`       // "creature","artifact","enchantment","land","permanent"; ""=any type
165		CountSubtype     string `json:"count_subtype,omitempty"`      // e.g. "Aura", "Aura|Equipment", "Swamp"; "|"-joined alternatives like AffectsSubtype
166		CountController  string `json:"count_controller,omitempty"`   // "you","opponent","any"/""=no restriction (battlefield mode only)
167		CountOther       bool   `json:"count_other,omitempty"`        // exclude e.Source itself (battlefield mode only)
168		CountCounterType string `json:"count_counter_type,omitempty"` // counter type name for "counters" mode, e.g. "charge","acorn","+1/+1"
169		CountLegendary   bool   `json:"count_legendary,omitempty"`    // require Card.Legendary too (battlefield mode only, e.g. "for each legendary creature you control")
170		CountModified    bool   `json:"count_modified,omitempty"`     // require isModifiedPermanent too (battlefield mode only, e.g. "for each modified creature you control" — Rule 700.15/Kamigawa NEO)
171		CountBasic       bool   `json:"count_basic,omitempty"`        // require Card.IsBasic too (battlefield mode only, e.g. "for each basic Swamp you control" — Cabal Stronghold)
172		CountNonBasic    bool   `json:"count_nonbasic,omitempty"`     // require a nonbasic permanent (battlefield mode only; normally paired with CountFilter "land")
173		CountMinPower    int    `json:"count_min_power,omitempty"`    // require Card.GetPowerWithEffects >= this (battlefield mode only, e.g. "for each creature with power 4 or greater you control" — Leafkin Avenger); 0 = no filter
174		// CountSumCounterType (battlefield mode only, task-1980 static_cost_mod):
175		// SUM this counter type ("+1/+1"|"any"|named) across every permanent

507	// EffectManager manages all active continuous effects
508	// Thread-safe for concurrent access
509	type EffectManager struct {
510		mu          sync.RWMutex
511		effects     []*ContinuousEffect
512		counter     int64      // For generating unique IDs
513		Battlefield *Zone      `json:"-"` // Reference to battlefield for evaluating variable modifiers
514		Game        *GameState `json:"-"` // Back-pointer to GameState so evaluatePerCount can delegate CountSpec to EvalDynamicAmount (task-2365: graveyard/hand/opponents count sources for pump_per_count)
515	}

517	// NewEffectManager creates a new EffectManager instance
518	func NewEffectManager() *EffectManager {
519		return &EffectManager{
520			effects: make([]*ContinuousEffect, 0),
521		}
522	}

524	// Register adds a new continuous effect
525	func (m *EffectManager) Register(e *ContinuousEffect) {
526		m.mu.Lock()
527		defer m.mu.Unlock()
528	
529		// Assign ID and timestamp if not set
530		if e.ID == "" {
531			m.counter++
532			e.ID = generateEffectID(m.counter)
533		}
534		if e.Timestamp == 0 {
535			e.Timestamp = time.Now().UnixNano()
536		}
537		if e.Source != nil {
538			e.SourceID = e.Source.ID
539			e.SourceController = e.Source.Controller
540		}
541		// Default layer for effect modifications (Rule 613)
542		if e.Layer == "" {
543			if e.StripAbilities {
544				e.Layer = "6" // Layer 6: ability-removing effects
545			} else if e.SetPower != nil || e.SetToughness != nil {
546				e.Layer = "7b"
547			} else if e.PowerMod != 0 || e.ToughnessMod != 0 ||
548				e.DynamicPowerMod != nil || e.DynamicToughnessMod != nil {
549				e.Layer = "7c"
550			} else if e.AddType != "" || len(e.SetSubTypes) > 0 || e.AddSubType != "" {
551				e.Layer = "4"
552			} else if len(e.SetColors) > 0 || e.AddColor != "" {
553				e.Layer = "5"
554			}
555		}
556	
557		m.effects = append(m.effects, e)
558	}

560	// RemoveBySource removes all effects generated by a specific card
561	func (m *EffectManager) RemoveBySource(card *Card) {
562		m.mu.Lock()
563		defer m.mu.Unlock()
564	
565		if card == nil {
566			return
567		}
568	
569		filtered := make([]*ContinuousEffect, 0, len(m.effects))
570		for _, e := range m.effects {
571			if e.SourceID != card.ID {
572				filtered = append(filtered, e)
573			}
574		}
575		m.effects = filtered
576	}

580		m.mu.Lock()
581		defer m.mu.Unlock()
582	
583		filtered := make([]*ContinuousEffect, 0, len(m.effects))
584		for _, e := range m.effects {
585			if e.ID != effectID {
586				filtered = append(filtered, e)
587			}

593	func (m *EffectManager) GetPowerBonus(card *Card, sourceControllerIdx int) int {
594		m.mu.RLock()

620	// evaluatePerCount is the executor for the pump_per_count v2 primitive
621	// (registry.go) — see the CountMode/CountFilter/... field comments on
622	// ContinuousEffect (effects.go) for the schema this reads.
623	func (m *EffectManager) evaluatePerCount(e *ContinuousEffect, sourceControllerIdx int) int {
624		// CountSpec (task-2365): a graveyard/hand/opponents/counters_on_others
625		// count source in the closed amount_count spec vocabulary — delegate to
626		// EvalDynamicAmount (game/dynamic_amount.go), the same resolver that
627		// backs one-shot dynamic amounts, rather than duplicating zone-counting
628		// here. Only used for count sources NOT already covered by the flat
629		// battlefield/counters fields above, so the proven path is unchanged
630		// for every existing pump_per_count record. EvalDynamicAmount's own
631		// battlefield/counters_on_source sub-cases synthesize a fresh
632		// ContinuousEffect WITHOUT a CountSpec, so there is no recursion.
633		if e.CountSpec != nil && m.Game != nil {
634			if n, ok := m.Game.EvalDynamicAmount(e.CountSpec, sourceControllerIdx, e.Source); ok {
635				return n
636			}
637			return 0
638		}
639		if e.CountCounterType != "" {
640			if e.Source == nil {
641				return 0
642			}
643			if e.CountCounterType == "any" {
644				// "for each counter on ~" (unqualified, e.g. Kyler, Sigardian
645				// Emissary) — sum every counter kind rather than one named type;
646				// "any" is a reparse.py sentinel, not a real CounterType.
647				total := 0
648				for _, n := range e.Source.Counters.AllCounts() {
649					total += n
650				}
651				return total
652			}
653			return e.Source.Counters.GetCount(CounterType(e.CountCounterType))
654		}
655		if m.Battlefield == nil {
656			return 0
657		}
658		n := 0
659		if e.CountMode == "attached_to_source" {
660			if e.Source == nil {
661				return 0
662			}
663			// Anchor is "whatever e.Source is itself attached to" when Source is
664			// an Aura/Equipment (e.g. Auramancer's Guise, an Aura: "Enchanted
665			// creature gets +2/+2 for each Aura attached to it" — "it" is the
666			// enchanted creature, not the Aura source, and the count includes
667			// the source Aura itself since it's attached there too), falling
668			// back to Source itself when Source isn't attached to anything
669			// (e.g. Kor Spiritdancer, a creature: "gets +2/+2 for each Aura
670			// attached to it" — "it" is the creature/source; or Heavenly
671			// Blademaster, whose bonus goes to OTHER creatures but still counts
672			// what's attached to the source itself).
673			anchor := e.Source.ID
674			if e.Source.AttachedTo != "" {
675				anchor = e.Source.AttachedTo
676			}
677			for _, c := range m.Battlefield.Cards {
678				if c == nil || c.AttachedTo != anchor {
679					continue
680				}
681				if matchesCountTypeSubtype(c, e.CountFilter, e.CountSubtype) {
682					n++
683				}
684			}
685			return n
686		}
687		// default: "battlefield" mode
688		sum := 0
689		for _, c := range m.Battlefield.Cards {
690			if c == nil {
691				continue
692			}
693			if e.CountOther && e.Source != nil && c.ID == e.Source.ID {
694				continue
695			}
696			switch e.CountController {
697			case "you":
698				if c.Controller != sourceControllerIdx {
699					continue
700				}
701			case "opponent":
702				if c.Controller == sourceControllerIdx {
703					continue
704				}
705			}
706			if e.CountLegendary && !c.Legendary {
707				continue
708			}
709			if e.CountModified && !isModifiedPermanent(m, c) {
710				continue
711			}
712			if e.CountBasic && !c.IsBasic {
713				continue
714			}
715			if e.CountNonBasic && c.IsBasic {
716				continue
717			}
718			if e.CountColorless && !c.IsColorless() {
719				continue
720			}
721			if e.CountNonToken && c.IsToken {
722				continue
723			}
724			if e.CountAttacking && !c.Attacking {
725				continue
726			}
727			if e.CountTapped && !c.Tapped {
728				continue
729			}
730			if e.CountMinPower > 0 && c.GetPowerWithEffects(m) < e.CountMinPower {
731				continue
732			}
733			if !matchesCountTypeSubtype(c, e.CountFilter, e.CountSubtype) {
734				continue
735			}
736			if e.CountColor != "" && !c.HasColor(e.CountColor) {
737				continue
738			}
739			if e.CountHasCounterType != "" {
740				if e.CountHasCounterType == "any" {
741					if !c.Counters.HasCounters() {
742						continue
743					}
744				} else if c.Counters.GetCount(CounterType(e.CountHasCounterType)) == 0 {
745					continue
746				}
747			}
748			if e.CountKeyword != "" && !c.HasKeyword(e.CountKeyword) {
749				continue
750			}
751			if e.CountSumCounterType != "" {
752				if e.CountSumCounterType == "any" {
753					for _, ct := range c.Counters.AllCounts() {
754						sum += ct
755					}
756				} else {
757					sum += c.Counters.GetCount(CounterType(e.CountSumCounterType))
758				}
759				continue
760			}
761			n++
762		}
763		if e.CountSumCounterType != "" {
764			return sum
765		}
766		return n
767	}
